# RRT-0376-009 — Columbiana EMA ENS/IPAWS current-plan exercise logs and records

Status marker: ready_not_sent_from_static_archive. This packet is not evidence and not proof of readiness.
Claim rule: no readiness conclusion may be drawn from this request, from a dispatch receipt, or from a route page. Only imported, hashed, redacted-where-needed, and adjudicated response records may affect proofcuts.
Redaction rule: please provide reasonably segregable public portions. Personal, medical, minor/student, security-sensitive, safeguards, tactical, or facility-vulnerability details may be redacted or summarized; preserve dates, custodians, objective/status, issue/CAP metadata, and public-facing evaluator conclusions where releasable.

## Request target

Columbiana County Emergency Management Agency / appropriate Columbiana County public-records custodian. If another county office holds public-records routing authority, please forward or identify the correct custodian.

## Why this request is narrowed

The current public Columbiana County BVPS Radiological Emergency Response Plan Rev. 38 identifies a 2026 change replacing WENS with ENS and includes an ENS/IPAWS Concept of Operations under Emergency Notification Methods and Procedures. This request therefore uses current terminology and asks for exercise-specific records, not general plan documents.

## Records requested

Please provide releasable records concerning the June 2026 Beaver Valley Power Station evaluated exercise and/or the June 12, 2026 11:00 a.m. results announcement that show how ENS/IPAWS/EAS/WEA/siren/public-warning functions were exercised, simulated, evaluated, or discussed, including:

1. ENS, Electronic Notification System, IPAWS, WEA, EAS, siren, public-warning, and emergency-notification exercise messages, message approvals, message templates, screenshots, simulations, delivery logs, failure/exception logs, evaluator observations, and after-action notes.
2. Records showing whether the Rev. 38 WENS-to-ENS change affected the exercise, message routing, alert credentials, operator actions, training, public warning timing, or corrective actions.
3. Any issue, deficiency, area for improvement, corrective-action, improvement-plan, retest, closure, or residual-risk record related to ENS/IPAWS/EAS/WEA/siren/public warning.
4. Redacted or summary records showing access and functional needs, language access, hearing/visual access, school warning, transportation-support warning, and special-needs/public-information handling for the exercise.
5. A record index for withheld records, with record type, date/time, custodian/agency, public-warning function, withholding basis, and whether a segregable summary can be released.

## Proofcuts targeted

PC-ANS-0374; PC-AFN-0374; PC-CAP-0374; PC-CHAIN-0374.

## Request target

Ohio Department of Public Safety Public Records Center / Ohio Emergency Management Agency / Radiological Branch. This is intended for the current Ohio public-records portal route and should be assigned to the public office that maintains Ohio EMA/Radiological Branch BVPS exercise records.

## Why this request is narrowed

The public Columbiana County plan now uses ENS language and includes an ENS/IPAWS Concept of Operations. Ohio EMA/Radiological Branch may hold state evaluator, public-warning, and corrective-action records that local or FEMA Region 3 packets will not capture.

## Records requested

Please provide releasable Ohio EMA / Radiological Branch / ODPS records concerning the June 2026 Beaver Valley Power Station exercise involving Columbiana County, including:

1. Controller/evaluator materials, evaluator notes, objective scoring, after-action notes, findings, strengths, areas for improvement, deficiencies, improvement-plan items, corrective actions, retest requirements, and closure records concerning ENS, Electronic Notification System, IPAWS, WEA, EAS, sirens, emergency notification, public warning, or alert credentials.
2. Records concerning the June 12, 2026 11:00 a.m. results announcement or any Ohio/Columbiana exercise-results briefing where ENS/IPAWS/public-warning performance, exceptions, or corrective actions were presented or discussed.
3. Records showing state-local-federal coordination with FEMA Region V, FEMA Region III, Columbiana County EMA, NRC, PEMA, Beaver County, Hancock County, or the licensee for the alert/notification portions of the exercise.
4. Redacted or summary records concerning AFN/language/hearing/visual access, special-needs registries, school warning, transportation-support warning, shelter/reception warning, and privacy controls.
5. For withheld material, a record index or segregable summary showing record type, date/time, custodian, exercise function, issue status, withholding basis, and whether CAP/retest was required or completed.

PC-ANS-0374; PC-AFN-0374; PC-CAP-0374; PC-CHAIN-0374.
